title: Magazine Street and Chartres jobs
summary: He recalls playing with Abbie and Howard on Sundays.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And what about Magazine Street and Chappatoulas, was there anything over that way in my childhood?

Well I used to work with Howard and them, sometimes after that job went under, with Abbie and Howard and Morgan, up at the line in Chappatoulas, and then later they built a place out near the river where I had left. Gee that's pretty near the river, Chappatoulas.

They built the front place out there. They got all the, oh you mean the patio? Yeah. Yeah, I used to go there and talk. This guy had a bar room there, I used to play there with Abbie and Howard in Malden. We used to play there on Sundays and different things. Then they built that other place out there where I had left then and I went on downtown, I started working with Boybanks and Al was what you call them.
What about Napoleon and Chappatoulas did you ever play that?
George Williams was playing out there. George Williams and somebody else. I don't know, I played out there one time with Bo Foster, somebody.
